title: WordPress Started Out as a Fork of a Little-Known Blogging Tool
content:
Did you know… 🤓

…that WordPress didn't start from scratch, but was actually a fork of an old, abandoned blogging tool called b2/cafelog?

In 2003, Matt Mullenweg and Mike Little took over the discontinued project and built it into the WordPress we know today. The name itself was suggested by a friend, Christine Selleck.

More than two decades later, this fork powers a huge portion of the web, proof that major open-source projects can grow from the smallest of beginnings.
